_help.about: Travellers on the road (design 30 Sept §BF): rare cloaked figures walking the roads, day and night. They never speak and never stop; the hood tracks you and holds a beat too long; the body never breaks stride. Restart after editing.
_help.per_km_of_road: Expected travellers per km of road at any moment.
_help.head_look: The §B rig capped at the hood: torso_max_deg 0. watch_m: they start tracking you this close. hold_s: how long the look holds after you pass before it returns to the road.
_help.immune_to_dread: §BA ignores them: they walk unharmed through the dark.
